ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) If a pipe A can fill a tank 3 times faster than pipe B. If both the pipes can fill the tank in 32 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Time is taken by pipe A = x
Time is taken by pipe B = x/3
1/x + 3/x = 1/32
x = 128 minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) A tank is filled in 5 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Suppose pipe A alone takes x hours to fill the tank.
Then, pipes B and C will take x/2 and x/4 hours respectively to fill the tank.
∴ 1/x + 2/x + 4/x = 1/5
⇒ 7/x = 1/5
⇒ x = 35 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) 3 workers can do a job in 12 days. Two of the workers work twice as fast as the third. How long it will take if one of the faster workers do the job himself?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
৩ জন শ্রমিক একটি কাজ ১২ দিনে করতে পারে।
এই ৩ জনের মধ্যে ২ জন ৩য় জনের তুলনায় দ্বিগুণ কাজ করতে পারে।
প্রথম দুজনের ১ জন শ্রমিকের কাজ = ২ × ৩য় শ্রমিকের কাজ।
সুতরাং ৩ জন শ্রমিকের কাজ = ৫ × ৩য় শ্রমিকের কাজ।
৫ × ৩য় শ্রমিক কাজটি করতে পারে = ১২ দিনে
৩য় শ্রমিক কাজটি করতে পারে = ৫ × ১২ দিনে = ৬০ দিনে।
২ × ৩য় শ্রমিক কাজটি করতে পারে = ৬০/২ দিনে = ৩০ দিনে
নির্ণেয় সময় = ৩০ দিন

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) Pipe A is 4 times as fast as B in filling a tank. If A takes 20 minutes to fill a tank, then what is the time taken by both the pipe A and B to fill the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
A takes 20 minutes and it is 4 times faster than B,
it means B will take 80 minutes to fill the tank.
(1/20 + 1/80) × t = 1.
So, We get t = 16.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) Tap B is 5 times slower than Tap A in filling the same tank. Also tap B takes 32 minutes more than Tap A to fill the same tank completely. How long will the tank take to get full, if both the taps are opened simultaneously?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let Tap A take T minutes to fill the tank alone.
Since Tap A is 5 times faster than Tap B, Tap B takes 5 times more time.
So time taken by Tap B = 5T minutes
Also, 5T-T = 32 ----------- Given
∴ T = 8 minutes = Time taken by A
Time taken by B = 5 x 8 = 40 minutes.

In 1 min, A + B fills = 1/8 + 1/40 = 3/20 parts
So entire tank is filled in = 20/3 hours.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) Three workers can do a job in 12 days. Two of the workers work twice as fast as the third. How long would it take one of the faster workers to do the job alone?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let, the first and 2nd worker need X days.
Third worker needs 2X days
ATQ, 1/X + 1/X + 1/2x = 1/12
or, (2 + 2 + 1)/2x = 1/12
or, x = 30

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) A clock slows down by one minute every 24 hours. How long will it take to slow down by one hour?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Since the clock takes 24 hours or 1 day to slow down by 1 minute.
So, it will take 60 days to slow down 60 minutes or 1 hour.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) A man takes twice as long to row a distance against the stream as to row the same distance in favour of the stream. The ratio of the speed of the boat (in still water) and the stream is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let man's rate upstream be x kmph
Then, his rate downstream = 2x kmph
∴ (speed in still water) : (Speed of stream)
=(2x+x)/2 : (2x−x)/2
= 3x/2 : x/2 = 3 : 1

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) Two pipes X and Y together can fill a tank in 72 minutes. If the size of the pipe X is thrice as Y then Y alone can fill the tank in -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let,
The time taken by Y alone to fill the tank be A minutes.
Given that, the size of the pipe X is thrice as Y.
Then, X fills the tank in A/3 minutes.
Part filled by X in 1 minute = 1/(A/3)
= 3/A
Part filled by Y in 1 minute = 1/A
Since, X and Y together take 72 minutes.
Part filled by (X + Y) in 1 minute = 1/72
i.e.,
(1/A + 3/A) = 1/72
⇒ 4/A = 1/72
A = 288 minutes
= (288/60) hours
= 4(48/60)
= 4(4/5) hours
= 4 hours and (4/5 x 60) minutes
= 4 hours and 48 minutes.
Hence, the pipe Y alone takes 4 hours and 48 minutes to fill the tank.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A train 360 metre long runs with a speed of 45 km/hr. What time will it take to pass a platform 140 metre long?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed = 45 km/hr = 45 × 5/18
= 25/2 m/s
Distance travelled = Length of the train + Length of the platform
= 360 + 140
= 500 metre.
Time taken to cross the platform = 500/(25/2)
= 40 seconds

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) A cistern can be filled by two pipes in 20 and 30 min respectively. Both pipes being open, when must the first pipe be turned off so that so that the cistern may be filled in 10 min more?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
In 1 min both pipes can fill = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12
In 10 min second pipe can fill = (1/30)×10 = 1/3 part
Part of cistern filled by both the pipes = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3
1/12 part is filled in 1 min
∴ 2/3 part will be filled in 12×2/3 = 8 min
Hence, first first pipe should be turned off after 8 min.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) In a race, the speeds of A and B are in the ratio 3:4. A takes 30 minutes more than B to reach the destination. The time taken by A to reach the destination is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Ratio of speeds = 3:4
Distance remaining constant, the ratio of time taken = 4:3
A takes 0.5 hours more than B
Hence time taken by A = 4 times 0.5 = 2 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) A track covers a distance of 550 metres in 1 minute whereas a bus covers a distance of 33 km in 45 minutes. The ratio of their speeds is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of track = 550 per minute.
Speed of bus
= 33km/45m
= 33000/45

∴ Ratio of their speeds
= 550 : 33000/45
= 24750 : 33000
= 8250 × 3 : 8250 × 4
= 3 : 4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) Three taps A, B and C fill a tank in 20 min, 15 min and 12 min, respectively. If all the taps are opened simultaneously, how long will they take to fill 40% of the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Part of the tank filled in 1 min by A, B and C.
1/20 + 1/15 + 1/12
= (3 + 4 + 5)/60
= 12/60
= 1/5

Therefore, Time taken by A, B and C to fill the tank = 5 min.
Therefore, Time taken by A, B and C to fill 40% of the tank
= 40% of 5 = 40/100 × 5 = 2 minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) A 240 m long train passed a pole in 24 seconds. How long will it take to pass a 650 m long platform?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Train’s speed = 240/24 = 10 m/s
The train has to cover = (240 + 650) = 890 m.
∴ Required time = 890/10 = 89 seconds

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) A man is walking at a speed of 10 kmph. After every km, he takes rest for 5 minutes. How much time will he take to cover a distance of 5 km?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Time taken by man if he did not stop = 5 km/10 kmph = 1/2 hr = 30 min
∵Man takes rest for 5 minutes on each km Total rest time= 5×4= 20 min
Total travelling time: = 30 min+20 min = 50 min

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) How long will a boy take to run round a square field of side 35 meters, If he runs at the rate of 9 km/hr?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed = 9 km/hr = 9 x (5/18) m/sec = 5/2 m/sec
Distance = (35 x 4) m = 140 m
Time taken = 140 x (2/5) sec = 56 sec

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) How long will a 150m long train running at a speed of 60 kmph take to cross a bridge of 300m?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total Distance = 300 + 150 = 450 m
Speed = 60 kmph = 60×(5/18)=(50/3) m/sec
Distance = Speed×Time
450 =(50/3)×Time
Time = 27 seconds

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) A train is moving at a speed of 132 km/hr. If the length of the train is 110 meters, how long it will take to cross a railway platform 165 meter long?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed = 132 km/hr = 132 × 5/18 m/s = 110/3 m/s
time = distance/speed = (110 + 165)/(110/3) = 7.5 seconds

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) A motor boat takes 12 hours to go downstream and it takes 24 hours to return the same distance. What is the time taken by boat in still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
If t1 and t2 are the upstream and down stream times.
Then time taken in still water is given by
(2 × t1 × t2) / (t1 + t2)
= (2 × 12 × 24) / 36
= 16h

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) To finish a work, A sets aside half additional time than B. In the event that together they take 18 days to finish the work, what amount of time might B take to do it?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Suppose B takes x days. Then,
A takes 150x/100 days, i.e. 3x/2 days
∴1/x+ 2/3x= 1/18 ⇒5/3x= 1/18 ⇒3x = 90 ⇒x= 30
Hence B takes 30 days.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) While going to office, Ramesh travels at a speed of 30 kmph and on his way back, he travels at a speed of 45 kmph. What is his average speed of the whole journey?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
When distance traveled is the same, then average speed = 2ab/(a+b); (where a and b are two different speeds)

Therefore,
Average Speed = 2 x 45 x {30/(45 + 30)}
= 36 kmph.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) A train takes 18 sec to pass completely through a station 162m long and 15 seconds through another station 120m long.The length of the train-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let length of the train be x m
Speed of train,
(x+162)/18 = (x+120)/15
∴ x = 90 m

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) Pipe A fills a tank in 24 minutes. Pipe B can fill the same tank 7 times as fast as Pipe A. If both the pipes are kept open when the tank is empty, when will the tank be full?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Pipe B will fill the tank in 24/7 minutes as it is 7 times as fast as Pipe A.
Together, the two pipes will fill 1/24 + 7/24
= 8/24
= 1/3rd of the tank in a minute.

So, it will take 3 minutes for the tank to overflow.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) A man travels equal distances of his journey at 15, 20 and 30 km/hour respectively. What is his average speed for whole journey?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Required average speed
= (3 × 15 × 20 × 30)/(15 × 20 + 20 × 30 + 30 × 15)
= 20 km/hour
----------------------------------------------------------------
Alternative way:
Distance 30 km, Speed 30 km/h, Time 1 Hour
Distance 30 km, Speed 15 km/h, Time 2 Hours
Distance 30 km, Speed 20 km/h, Time 1 hour & 30 minutes.
Total Distance 90 km, Total Time 4.5 Hours,
Average Speed 90/4.5 km/h = 20 km/h
--------------------------------------------------------------
Alternative way:
Let, equal distances travelled by the man be ’s’.
Time taken to travel first distance, s at 15 kmph = s/15
Time taken to travel second distance, s at 20 kmph = s/20
Tine taken to travel last distance, s at 30 kmph = s/30
Therefore, total time taken by the man = s(1/15 +1/20 +1/30)
Total distance travelled by the man = 3s
Hence, average speed of the man
= 3s / [ s(1/15 +1/20 +1/30) ] =3/(1/15 +1/20 +1/30)
= 20 kmph
---------------------------------------------------------------
Alternative way:
Avg speed formula= 3 ÷ (1/x +1/y +1/z)
Now we have 1/30 +1/20 +1/15
L.C.M. of 20, 30 and15 is 60.
Then (3 + 4 + 8)/60=9/60 = 3/20
From above formula, average speed = 3 ÷ 3/20=20 km/h

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) Arif travels 1/3rd of the distance at an average speed of 5 km/hr, 2/5the of the distance at an average speed of 4 km/hr and the rest 12 miles in 2 hours. What is the total distance traveled by Arif?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Distance = X
Distance covered at 5km and 4 km = x/3 + 2x/5
= (5x + 6x)/15
= 11x/15
Rest of the distance = 1 - 11x/15 = 4x/15
ATQ,
4x/15 = 12
or, x = (12 × 15)/4
or, x = 45.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) With an uniform speed, a car covers a distance in 8 hours. Had the speed been increased by 4 km/hr, the same distance could have been covered in 7 hr and 30 min. What is the distance covered?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of car be x km/hr
Distance= Speed × Time
Distance = 8x km
According to the question,
⇒ (x+4)×7.5= 8x
⇒ 7.5x+30= 8x
⇒ 8x−7.5x= 30
⇒ 0.5x= 30
⇒x= (30/0.5)= 60 km/hr
Required distance: = 8 × 60 = 480 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৮) A bus is running with a uniform speed of 37 km/h. What distance will be covered by bus at 8 h?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
We know that, speed = Distance/Time
Therefore, Required distance = Speed × Time
=37 × 8
= 296km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) A Man travelled a distance of 61 km in 9 hours. He travelled partly on foot at 4 km/hr and partly on bicycle at 9 km/hr. What is the distance travelled on foot?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the time in which he traveled on foot = x hour
Time for travelling on bicycle = (9-x) hr
Distance = Speed×Time, and Total distance = 61 km
So,
4x + 9(9-x) = 61
=> 5x = 20
=> x = 4
So distance traveled on foot = 4x4 = 16 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) Walking at the rate of 4 kmph a man cover certain distance in 2 hr 45 min. Running at a speed of 16.5 kmph the man will cover the same distance in.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Distance = Speed × time
Here time = 2hr 45 min = 11/4 hr
Distance = 4× (11/4)= 11 km
New Speed =16.5 kmph
Therefore time = D/S = 11/16.5 = 40 min
